newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS seeks to acquire Pelangi Air.
newsitem.headline: MAS seeks to acquire Pelangi Air.

text.p: Malaysian Airline System Bhd (MAS) has proposed the acquisition of Pelangi Air Sdn Bhd, a spokeswoman for the national airline said on Wednesday.

The spokeswoman was confirming a report from national news agency Bernama which quoted MAS chairman Tajudin Ramli as saying that the MAS board has approved the acquisition and Pelangi Air's board was expected to meet soon to consider MAS offer.
Pelangi Air is Malaysia's second national airline after MAS, and is 18 percent owned by MAS parent Malaysian Helicopter Services Bhd.
"The proposed acquisition of Pelangi Air would fit in nicely with MAS' business strategy and tie in well with MAS' passenger service operations," Tajudin told Bernama in an interview on Tuesday.
He declined to divulge details of the proposed acquisition, and a MAS spokeswoman also declined to give further information on the proposed purchase. -- Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603 230 8911)
